description: Ṭarsh in Arabic: block-printed text, probably for use as an amulet. Unidentified content. See Karl R. Schaefer, Enigmatic Charms: Medieval Arabic Block Printed Amulets in American and European Libraries and Museums (2006), in Richard W. Bulliet, "Medieval Arabic Tarsh: A Forgotten Chapter in the History of Printing," JAOS 107 (1987) or in Mark Muehlhaeusler, "Eight Arabic Block Prints from the Collection of Aziz S. Atiya," Arabica 55 (2008). MR
description_he: טרש בערבית: טקסט מודפס בהדפסת בלוקים, ככל הנראה לשימוש כקמיע. התוכן לא זוהה. ראו קרל ר' שפר, Enigmatic Charms: Medieval Arabic Block Printed Amulets in American and European Libraries and Museums (2006), ריצ'רד ו' בוליט, "Medieval Arabic Tarsh: A Forgotten Chapter in the History of Printing", JAOS 107 (1987), או מארק מיהלהויזלר, "Eight Arabic Block Prints from the Collection of Aziz S. Atiya", Arabica 55 (2008).
